qualifier: post-embryonic, with hyaloid vessel regression and developmental cell death
name: Post-embryonic eye maturation and hyaloid vessel regression
rationale: All members concern later eye development (lens, cornea, eyelid maturation) and the programmed death/regression of hyaloid vessels and retinal cells, which the embryonic optic cup/iris confusable lacks.

qualifier: calcium-triggered vesicle docking, priming and exocytosis
name: Calcium-triggered synaptic vesicle priming and neurotransmitter exocytosis
rationale: Members cover the release cycles of multiple transmitters, presynaptic calcium entry, SNARE assembly, vesicle docking/priming and calcium-dependent exocytosis, distinguishing it from vesicle recycling/endocytosis and postsynaptic glutamate-receptor confusables.

qualifier: prefoldin-CCT folding of actin and tubulin
name: Prefoldin-CCT chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
rationale: All members describe de novo folding by the cytosolic CCT/TRiC chaperonin with prefoldin delivery and post-chaperonin tubulin folding, unlike the tubulin modification, ER folding and telomerase confusables.

qualifier: C-type lectin sensing driving IL-17/Th17 responses
name: Antifungal C-type lectin sensing driving IL-17/Th17 immunity
rationale: Members combine Dectin-1/Dectin-2/DC-SIGN fungal recognition with IL-23, IL-17, Th17 commitment and IL-36/IL-38 mucosal cytokines, whereas confusables centre on IL-10/IL-12/IL-27 regulatory cytokines.

core: Vitamin and cofactor metabolism and transport
qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinone, plus cytochrome P450 defects
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E, ubiquinone metabolism and P450 defects
rationale: Members cover B1, B2 and vitamin E metabolism/transport and quinone synthesis plus inherited CYP and SLCO2A1 disorders, distinguishing it from cobalamin, coenzyme A and carnitine/choline confusables.

qualifier: photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance
name: Ciliary cargo targeting and photoreceptor outer segment development
rationale: Members combine BBSome/ARL13B/VxPx cargo delivery to the primary cilium with photoreceptor rod/cone outer segment development, which intraflagellar-transport and motile-cilia confusables lack.

qualifier: Fanconi monoubiquitination cycle and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects
name: Fanconi crosslink repair, monoubiquitination and BRCA defects
rationale: Members centre on the Fanconi anemia interstrand crosslink pathway with its monoubiquitination/deubiquitination switch and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 loss-of-function, unlike the NHEJ and homologous recombination confusables.

qualifier: arterial, venous and lymphatic
name: Arterial, venous and lymphatic endothelial cell fate specification
rationale: All members concern endothelial differentiation into arterial, venous and lymphatic identities, whereas confusables emphasise BMP signalling, vessel maturation and cardiac/pulmonary vasculature.

qualifier: inherited surfactant dysfunction
name: Pulmonary surfactant metabolism and inherited surfactant dysfunction
rationale: All members concern surfactant homeostasis and ABCA3, SFTPA2 and SFTPB disease variants, distinct from lipoprotein/ABC lipid transport and lung epithelial development confusables.

core: Polyamine metabolism and specialised residue modification
qualifier: peptidyl methylation, hydroxylation, hypusine and diphthamide
name: Polyamine metabolism and peptidyl methylation, hydroxylation and hypusination
rationale: Members join polyamine synthesis, interconversion and transport with spermidine-derived hypusine, diphthamide, wybutosine and protein lysine/arginine methylation and hydroxylation, which confusables split between them or lack.

qualifier: mtDNA replication and transcription through translation
name: Mitochondrial genome replication, transcription, RNA processing and translation
rationale: Members span mtDNA replication/repair, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing and stability, mitoribosome assembly and translation, whereas confusables cover generic RNA modification or nuclear tRNA processing.

qualifier: postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking
name: Synaptic cytoskeleton organization and postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking
rationale: Members combine pre- and postsynaptic cytoskeleton and active-zone maintenance with endosomal neurotransmitter receptor localization and internalization, unlike the clathrin-mediated vesicle endocytosis confusables.

qualifier: lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
name: Protein lysine/arginine methylation and lysine/proline hydroxylation
rationale: All members are peptidyl methylation or hydroxylation, distinguishing it from hypusine/diphthamide, histone methylation and acetylation confusables.

qualifier: elastic fibers and collagen fibrils
name: Elastic fiber assembly and collagen fibril organization
rationale: Members concern elastic fibre components and assembly with collagen fibril organization, while confusables centre on collagen biosynthesis, integrin/fibronectin adhesion or basement membrane.

qualifier: NADPH oxidase activation and myeloid chemotaxis
name: Leukocyte Rho GTPase signaling for NADPH oxidase and chemotaxis
rationale: Members involve RHOH, Cdc42 and Rac-driven NADPH oxidase signaling with dendritic cell chemotaxis and lymphocyte homing, which chemokine and immunological-synapse confusables lack.

qualifier: netrin and ephrin cues with fasciculation
name: Netrin and ephrin-driven axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members are netrin/DCC attraction and repulsion, ephrin-induced growth cone collapse, Rac1 activation and fasciculation, distinguishing it from L1 and ROBO-SLIT confusables.

qualifier: coronavirus replicase and host translation subversion
name: Coronavirus genome replication, translation and host translation subversion
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation, frameshifting, capping and replication plus evasion of PKR/IFIT and host translation control, unlike retroviral, RSV and influenza confusables.

qualifier: cAMP synthesis and degradation with Gq-calcium crosstalk
name: GPCR-driven cAMP synthesis and degradation with calcium crosstalk
rationale: Members regulate adenylate cyclase, cAMP synthesis and calmodulin-PDE breakdown together with PLC/IP3 calcium signaling, whereas confusables emphasise adrenergic inhibition, PKA/CREB or lysophospholipid receptors.

qualifier: Na+/K+-ATPase-maintained sodium, potassium and magnesium gradients
name: Na+/K+-ATPase-maintained sodium, potassium and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Members cover P-type ATPase ion transport, glycoside response and Na+, K+ and Mg2+ homeostasis, unlike potassium-channel excitability and paracellular magnesium confusables.

qualifier: replication fork reversal
name: DNA topology change and replication fork reversal
rationale: All three members concern changes in DNA geometry or topology, including fork reversal, unlike the telomere maintenance and protein-DNA crosslink confusables.

qualifier: copper and manganese, with metallothionein/MTF1 responses
name: Copper and manganese homeostasis with metallothionein metal responses
rationale: Members cover copper and manganese transport and homeostasis plus MTF1/metallothionein responses to zinc, copper and iron, distinguishing it from cadmium detoxification and zinc transporter confusables.

core: Secondary lymphoid tissue development and lymphocyte homing
qualifier: mucosal lymphoid tissue and B cell homing
name: Mucosal and nodal lymphoid tissue development and B cell homing
rationale: Members combine lymph node and MALT/GALT development with B cell chemotaxis, marginal zone differentiation and lymphocyte entry to lymphoid organs, while confusables are T cell/myeloid migration and S1P signalling.

qualifier: glucocorticoid and circadian regulation of gluconeogenesis and beta cells
name: Glucocorticoid and circadian control of gluconeogenesis and beta cells
rationale: Members join glucocorticoid response, BMAL1/CLOCK rhythms, gluconeogenesis and beta cell development/proliferation, unlike the cortisol-secretion and core clock/PPAR confusables.

name: Cytoplasmic stress granule assembly and disassembly
rationale: All members concern stress granule assembly, disassembly and protein recruitment, unlike aggrephagy and proteasome confusables.

qualifier: glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
name: Negative regulation of insulin-stimulated glucose uptake and glycogen synthesis
rationale: Members restrain insulin receptor signaling, glucose import and glycogen synthesis, whereas confusables promote glucose import (GLUT4, adiponectin) or concern glucagon-driven glycogenolysis.
